name: nowrap-label
note: white-space:nowrap suppresses wrapping: a label wider than its 120px box lays out on one line and overflows the box (matching Chrome's single fragment and the 22px element height). Newlines collapse to spaces, so no break is possible.

harvest.html: a very long single line label that overflows the box

measureText.text: a very long single line label that overflows the box
